entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ILLink.RoslynAnalyzer.DynamicallyAccessedMembersAnalyzer throws InvalidCastException: Cannot cast NonErrorNamedTypeSymbol to IMethodSymbol #80843
  • "Convert to LINQ" generates code with errors if the loop body contains a method call with an `out var` parameter #80841
  • Stack overflow in `ErrorFacts.IsBuildOnlyDiagnostic` #80840
  • Consider tests demonstrating a runtime null reference exception when iterating over null. #80838
  • Extremely slow build times when using local functions and `<AnalysisMode>All</AnalysisMode>` #80834
  • Compiler let's you create collection types with required properties with a collection expression. #80833
  • Attempted TextBuffer edit operation while another edit is in progress + memory leak + crash #80832
  • It looks like `CheckUnderspecifiedGenericExtension` is going to crash for an extension block declared in a namespace #80829
    18.3

Closed

  • Undeserved error when foreach loop used on null enumerable #45616
    Backlog
  • Provide better API and documentation for SyntaxReferences of partial methods #22598
    Backlog
  • "Convert to 'field' property" changes semantics when get-only property has same name as primary constructor parameter #80771
  • Roslyn 4.3 API is not backward compatible with Roslyn 4.2 because of ExclamationExclamationToken #62671
    Backlog
  • Remove TryGetUnmatchedInParameterAndFreeMatchedArgs() if not needed #62054
    Backlog
  • CompilationWithAnalyzer.GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync returns 0 diagnostics even though the analyzers do run & report #61851
    Backlog
  • Add 'automatically remove closing curly bracket when corresponding opening curly bracket has been removed' feature #61626
    Backlog
  • "Remove unnecessary parentheses" does not trigger for parenthesized simple constant value after binary OR operator #80777

PullRequests

Created

  • Only set DOTNET_HOST_PATH if something was installed #80842
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add runtime NullReferenceException validation to foreach null iteration tests #80839
    Area-Compilers, Test
  • Get solution explorer symbol view working on .Net Fx projects #80837
    Area-IDE
  • Use standard lookup and overload resolution for `true`/`false` operators while binding applications of user-defined `&&`/`||` operators #80836
    Area-Compilers
  • More tests for 'with(...)' element scenarios. #80831
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Extensions: address some diagnostic quality issues #80827
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode

Merged

  • Clean up a Razor external access service #80830
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Remove unused statement #80823
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Allow foreach on typed null enumerables #80783
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Update documentation for DeclaringSyntaxReferences and Locations to clarify partial members behavior #80704
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Test, Next
  • Fix issue converting an auto prop to a full prop when 'field' and 'initializers' are involved #80773
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Improve error reporting for 'with(...)' argument diagnostics. Address several PROTOTYPE comments. #80805
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Fix ITypeSymbol.BaseType documentation for type parameters #80770
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix "Remove unnecessary parentheses" analyzer to detect primary precedence expressions in bitwise operations #80779
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Completion for `#:project` paths (round 2) #80844
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add support for renaming nested types with Outer.Inner.cs file naming convention #80727
    VSCode
  • Remove warning from 'in enum' extension methods #80708
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Target-Typed New
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Extensions: Add ReduceExtensionMember API #80659
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality
  • Fix handling of SymbolDisplayCompilerInternalOptions.UseArityForGenericTypes option for non-native symbol implementations #80826
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix rename conflict detection for local functions and lambdas #80821
    VSCode
  • Mark CS4009 error as a "build only" error. #80698
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Copilot: Fix culture-sensitive StringBuilder.Append calls across codebase and add banned symbols #80800
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Simplifying internal structure and logic for the SyntaxNodeCache #80825
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix go to definition for conversions on invalid constructor overloads #78514
    Area-Compilers, Need More Info, Community, untriaged
